entries.title: Metal Gear Solid HD Collection

emulation.notes: Original PS3/Xbox 360 hardware is the official route.

primary.why: The PS3/Xbox 360 HD Collection includes MGS2, MGS3, Peace Walker, and the MSX2 games, while Vita omits Peace Walker; PS3 is the best completeness pick for the collection itself.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PS3 HD Collection if archiving the collection as a package; use Master Collection/Delta entries for modern individual routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Superseded for many individual games by Master Collection/modern PC routes, but still important for Peace Walker and package history.

entries.title: Metal Gear Solid: The Legacy Collection

emulation.notes: Original PS3 is the official package route.

primary.why: Legacy Collection is a PS3-only archival box containing HD Collection, MGS4, graphic novels, and vouchers for MGS/VR Missions, making it the most complete pre-Master physical package.
primary.how_to_play: Use a PS3 and verify voucher/digital availability; for normal play, use modern individual recommendations where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Vouchers/digital availability should be verified before calling a copy complete.
